egenvaegt.hjaelp: The manufacturer's own weight figure. Note that some state it with the battery and some without.

hoejde.hjaelp: Standing dimension. Several manufacturers publish more than one height for the same robot.

nyttelast_gaaende.hjaelp: The load the robot carries while walking. This is the figure the catalogue ranks on.

nyttelast_staaende.hjaelp: The load the robot carries standing still. It can be several times the walking figure and must never be compared with it.

hastighed.hjaelp: Read the operator: some manufacturers publish a lab figure, others an operating speed.

haeldning.hjaelp: Some manufacturers state a percentage rather than degrees. We do not convert silently.

forhindring_enkelt.hjaelp: Highest single obstacle. Not comparable with continuous stair climbing.

trappetrin_kontinuerlig.hjaelp: Step height the robot climbs in sequence. It is the only one of the two step fields comparisons may use.

ip_klasse.hjaelp: Ingress protection against dust and water.

temp_min.hjaelp: Lower operating temperature. Decisive for outdoor use in Denmark.

batteri_wh.hjaelp: Only where the manufacturer prints Wh. We never derive Wh from mAh and volts.

driftstid.hjaelp: Without a load condition one runtime is not comparable with another.

ladetid.hjaelp: Read the condition: some state time to 80 %, others to full.

lidar.hjaelp: Type and model. A type without a model does not count as a disclosure.

kameraer.hjaelp: Count, type and where possible model.

compute.hjaelp: Compute unit carried on the robot.

ros2.hjaelp: ROS without a version number does not count as ROS 2.

autonominiveau.hjaelp: Descriptive, not a scale. No manufacturer publishes a level.

stroem_ud.hjaelp: Voltage and power per port. Most manufacturers state only the voltage.

pris.hjaelp: Contact sales is not a price. We never reproduce a figure the manufacturer itself calls a placeholder.

eu_tilgaengelig.hjaelp: Whether the manufacturer states that the model can be bought in the EU.

ce_oplyst.hjaelp: Whether the manufacturer STATES CE — not whether the robot has CE. A missing CE statement does not mean the same thing for an EU manufacturer as for a US one.

eu_service.hjaelp: Whether the manufacturer states a service point in the EU.

leveringstid.hjaelp: Whether the manufacturer states a lead time.

ikke_oplyst.hjaelp: The manufacturer does not publish it. That is not the same as zero, and not the same as no.

nej.hjaelp: The manufacturer explicitly answers no. That is a disclosure, not a gap.

kun_billede.hjaelp: The manufacturer publishes it, but only inside an image that cannot be quoted as text.

ui.variantforskel: The value applies to one variant — see the caveat
ui.taethed_forklaring: The share of fields the manufacturer publishes itself. It measures openness, not suitability.
ui.ingen_forhandleraftale: KeyResearch has no reseller agreement with any manufacturer on this site.
